statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. The holiday-reopen gap is modest and persistent post-reopen mean-reversion failure is not independently verified.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. The next concentrated checkpoint is Tuesday's U.S. cash open, where gap persistence and pullback quality determine whether Tail rises.
headline: Nasdaq Tail falls below WATCH after a modest holiday-reopen gap
body: A delayed NQ post-reopen print shows 29,548.75 versus a 29,603.50 prior close, while granular follow-through remains incomplete. Oil and Gulf escalation keep Stress extreme, but mixed internals do not establish a pathological one-way NQ path.

sources.title: University of Michigan — Surveys of Consumers

lookbackSummary: All 24 preceding UTC hours are available. Tail ranged 18%-24%, Stress remained 100%, and dominant mode stayed event/whipsaw.
outlookSummary: Base Tail stays below the blocking threshold overnight. The main conditional risk concentration shifts to Tuesday's U.S. cash open; only an unrepaired gap with failed pullbacks and aligned cross-asset pressure lifts Tail into the elevated band.

forecast.analysis: Observed reopen evidence is modest: a delayed NQ print shows 29,548.75 versus a 29,603.50 prior close. Granular follow-through remains incomplete, so persistent failed-retracement structure is not established.
drivers: Post-reopen price path remains only partly observable
Oil and Hormuz risk keep external stress extreme

forecast.analysis: Conditional 01:00: continued overlap around the reopen range favors low Tail. A one-way second leg with failed retracements would move the path back toward WATCH.
Conditional 02:00: deeper pullbacks and stable overnight ranges would reinforce mean reversion; directional efficiency without repair would raise Tail.
Conditional 03:00: Asian-session participation tests whether the reopen impulse is absorbed. Balanced rotation keeps Tail low; repeated extension does not.
Conditional 04:00: volatility decay and wider two-sided trade favor low Tail. Fresh geopolitical escalation or a renewed directional burst would lift risk asymmetrically.

forecast.analysis: Conditional 05:00: a stable overnight range keeps Tail low despite high external Stress. A fresh break that resists retracement would weaken that base case.
Conditional 06:00: pre-Europe structure remains low Tail if neither side holds near an extreme. Persistent extreme holding would increase risk ahead of Europe.
Conditional 07:00: Europe-open flows raise Tail to WATCH as a transition risk; confirmation requires an unrepaired overnight trend or aligned cross-asset pressure.

Conditional 11:00: U.S. premarket participation begins to matter more. Tail remains WATCH unless futures develop an unrepaired gap or failed-retracement sequence.
Conditional 12:00: proximity to the U.S. cash open raises Tail within WATCH. Cross-asset alignment matters only if NQ structure also becomes persistently one-way.

forecast.analysis: Conditional 13:00: the final pre-open hour is upper WATCH. A widening directional gap that resists repair would set up the cash-open danger window.
Conditional 14:00: elevated Tail requires the cash opening auction to extend an unrepaired gap with shallow or failed pullbacks and repeated directional expansion.
Conditional 15:00: meaningful repair after the first cash hour returns WATCH; persistent extension near session extremes would keep the elevated case alive.
Conditional 16:00: if opening volatility is absorbed, Tail eases through WATCH. Continued one-way efficiency would delay normalization.
Conditional 17:00: midday two-sided trade lowers risk. A geopolitical shock or yield/oil surge aligned with one-way NQ structure would re-expand Tail.

forecast.analysis: Conditional 19:00: Consumer Credit is a medium checkpoint. Tail rises only if the release coincides with persistent directional NQ structure and failed retracements.
Conditional 20:00: orderly post-release discovery favors WATCH normalization; repeated extension without repair would keep Tail higher.
Conditional 21:00: late cash-session balance supports low Tail. Persistent trend efficiency into the close would invalidate that normalization.
Conditional 22:00: the next Globex session begins low Tail if the cash close was orderly and two-sided; an unresolved directional second leg would raise risk.

forecastDetail.comment: The observed reopen gap is modest, but follow-through evidence remains incomplete; Tail is below WATCH while Stress stays extreme.
Low Tail persists conditionally if the first full hour repairs or remains two-sided; shallow-pullback extension would invalidate it.
Continued overlap favors low Tail; a clean second leg after failed retracements would move risk back toward WATCH.
Deeper pullbacks and range stability favor mean reversion; unrepaired directional efficiency would raise Tail.
Asian participation is an absorption test: balanced rotation supports low Tail, while repeated extension does not.
Volatility decay supports low Tail; renewed directional expansion or fresh geopolitical escalation would increase risk.
